articles.title: Xbox Game Pass Loses These 9 Games In October
articles.summary: The start of the month usually brings several new Xbox Game Pass titles for subscribers, along with confirmation of which games will leave the subscription service in the coming days.
body: Other big departures this month include A Plague Tale: Requiem and-- inconveniently for horror fans during the spookiest month of the year--the Dead by Daylight spin-off The Casting of Frank Stone. Evil West is another great game you only have a few days left to play, with a solid 7/10 experience full of monster-slaying energy.
Pacific Drive was another one of our favorites when it was released a few years back, as this eerie roguelite driving game combined a tense atmosphere with themes of mystery and survival.
As a reminder, you can save 20% on these games if you decide to buy them before they leave Game Pass.
September was a pretty big month for Game Pass removals, with a total of 18 games packing their bags. The list included some big titles, like The Witcher 3, Cyberpunk 2077, Sifu, and Frostpunk 2.

articles.title: MTG’s Hobbit Cards Are the Closest Thing to Owning Rare Tolkien Memorabilia, and Perfect for Collectors
articles.summary: For the second time, and likely the last, Magic: The Gathering has taken players back to Middle-Earth with its The Hobbit set (its fifth of the year, if you can believe it), and it’s been pretty great.
body: That’s perhaps to be expected since the original book laid out a lot of what we consider fantasy tropes. Dragons, goblins, dwarves, and more are represented here in a smaller set than the Lord of the Rings one, all of which have gone on to inspire Magic cards in their own right.

Still, given how tricky it can be to get some products, there’s a good chance that finding Hobbit items can feel like searching for the Arkenstone in Smaug’s treasure hoard. And yet, it feels like, in a way, that’s kind of the point.
J.R.R. Tolkien’s influence on the world of fantasy cannot be overstated, and there’s a reason that so many early editions of his works have fetched colossal sums of money.
As an example, back in 2025, a fully signed Lord of the Rings first-edition set sold for around £287,700 (or $337,000). That marks the high point of spending, but it’s not an outlier by any stretch.

articles.title: Disney+ Shows and Movies Are Now Headed to Netflix, Including Ice Age and Percy Jackson
articles.summary: Disney plans to license Ice Age, Percy Jackson and more to Netflix as part of a new deal between the two firms. In the deal, Netflix will host select Disney+ content for its 325 million subscribers, including a mix of legacy titles and currently streaming TV shows.
body: All five 20th Century Studios’ Ice Age movies will land on Netflix at the same time as Percy Jackson. Will Trent Seasons 1-4, Shifting Gears Seasons 1-2, and Tracker Seasons 1-3 are also heading to Netflix between November this year and February 2027.

In 2027, a range of Walt Disney Animation and Pixar movies will also head to Netflix, including Soul, Elio, and Raya and the Last Dragon, along with a selection of complete series such as Felicity, This is Us, Revenge, and Fresh off the Boat. Release dates for these vary by region.

According to the Variety exclusive, this will be a mutually beneficial deal, with Netflix getting more content and Disney getting more eyes on the kind of things it offers outside of its biggest franchise titles (and presumably some cash).
Netflix recently announced its streaming lineup for October, which includes miniseries East of Eden, Ben Affleck’s Animals, and Josh Hartnett squaring off against a sea beast in Below.

articles.title: In 5 Years, Will Netflix Still Be In Gaming? Here’s What The CEO Said
articles.summary: Netflix has been experimenting with video games for a while, but is the streaming giant going to eventually drop out of gaming? That's the question Bloomberg's Lucas Shaw put to Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos at the Screentime event this week.
body: Regarding whether Netflix will still host games in five years, Sarandos said, "I think so." He said Netflix's push into mobile gaming was "a gateway to cloud gaming," which is something Netflix is "much more interested in."

Netflix hosts a variety of mobile games, including Red Dead Redemption, Sonic Mania Plus, and RollerCoaster Tycoon Touch, just to name a few. The games are included with a Netflix membership and have no ads. Netflix also hosts streaming games that can be played on your TV, and they are more family- and party-focused.

Netflix's gaming ambitions have bounced around over the years. At one point, the company wanted to make big, AAA games, and hired some big names to get it done. However, Netflix later wound down these efforts, closing studios and laying off staff in the process, leading many to wonder what Netflix's ambition for video games actually was.

articles.title: James Gunn's DCU Reportedly Safe Following Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger, for Now at Least
articles.summary: DC Studios co-CEOs James Gunn and Peter Safran will seemingly keep their vision for the DCU alive following the Paramount-Warner Bros. merger. Rumors that the two comic book movie executives would be shuffled out amidst the tumultuous merger have swirled for months.
body: Puck has reported that both creatives "will be invited to stay on at DC, at least initially" as all the moving pieces come together behind the scenes. What the long-term future holds remains to be seen, but it sounds like more DC movies and shows will continue to fall in line as the DCU navigates its early ups and downs.

Adding weight to the continuation of the current iteration of the DC universe is Gunn himself. After that new Skydance title was announced, the former Marvel director took to Instagram to celebrate the news by sharing its flashy new trailer. Included amongst the cuts of Paramount and Warner Bros. logos are shots from Superman, Robert Pattinson's The Batman, and even the DC logo itself.
"What once was the peak, is now just the beginning," Gunn, echoing the trailer, said in the post's caption.

Gunn and Safran officially took over the DC entertainment business in 2022 and will continue to oversee it – at least through 2027. That's when their contracts are set to expire, and while there are plenty of other projects set to release before then, whether they'll choose to renew under new leadership remains to be seen.

articles.title: Sony’s Revised PS5 Slim Could Be Getting Cheaper To Make, But Not To Buy
articles.summary: It looks like Sony has quietly revised the PS5 console once again, with new internal changes across the (mother)board. It's not clear when these new models came into service, but they seem to have entered circulation around the same time Sony released limited-edition Marvel's Wolverine PS5…
body: Spotted by Modyfikator89, longevity and repairability appear to be the key areas that Sony has focused on. The redesigned motherboard offers easier access to the CR2023 battery, the streamlined internal layout makes repairs less risky, and the hardware takes a page from the PS5 Pro playbook with refined liquid-metal containment and revised heatsink materials. In theory, the updated barrier around the processor die should keep the liquid metal better contained over time, ensuring stable thermal transfer performance even under intensive loads.

Sony has also moved to a newer, lower-cost HDMI retimer chip, which likely cuts down bill-of-materials costs and improves display signal stability. Overall, this will likely lower production costs while maintaining higher assembly yields, at a time when sourcing components has become more challenging. Companies routinely make stealth revisions to cut manufacturing costs, but unlike previous console generations that shrank and became cheaper over time, the PS5 has only gotten more expensive since it launched in November 2020.

articles.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 boss hopes GTA 6 pushes game prices up because it's "long overdue and also necessary for this business to survive"
articles.summary: Warhorse Studios co-founder Martin Klima - the developer behind last year's historical RPG Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 - is crossing his fingers for higher game prices, and he thinks GTA 6 might be the one to usher in a new normal.
body: Speaking to PC Gamer in a recent interview, the studio boss explained that the games industry is facing a few major problems. The cost of game development has ballooned wildly in recent years, but the audience that regularly buys new games has somewhat peaked. On top of that, the move to digital storefronts means the middle-man of retail is more or less cut out: "We destroyed retail, and we took all their money."

So, how else can studios maximise cash flow without stuffing games full of microtransactions? "The last thing you can do is to increase the unit price," Klima said. "That would help a lot, but everybody's scared to death about it. Now, hopefully, GTA will blaze the trail, and it will allow us to increase the cost."

According to Klima, Rockstar Games and parent company Take-Two are the last ones "who can afford, or who can dare, to increase the price of games, which I think is long overdue and also necessary for this business to survive. So I wish them all the luck."

articles.title: Fourth Wing Author Officially Confirms a Major Fan Theory in New Book
articles.summary: Threshing Day, the latest entry in the Empyrean series released Sept. 29, is a novella in the Fourth Wing universe. It features 13 short stories, each one focused on a character from the mainline books. The first chapter focuses on Brennan Sorrengail, Violet and Mira's older brother.
body: This article contains major spoilers for Fourth Wing, Iron Flame, and Threshing Day (Chapter 1).

Even though Brennan was not physically present for most of his sisters' lives (at least the periods that we've seen), Brennan was able to help Violet and Mira during their time in the Riders Quadrant at Basgiath War College through The Book of Brennan. It's essentially a private survival manual he wrote specifically to help his sisters when they undertook the same challenges he did.

After Violet bonds with the dragon Tairn, she eventually learns about "the one who came before" — Tairn's previous rider, Naolin. His siphon signet allowed him to redistribute energy, but when he attempted to use it to resurrect a fallen rider in battle, it killed him. That rider was Brennan. To much of the world, Brennan did die. But as we learn at the end of book one, he survived and took an alias.
"I glimpse a rune-shaped scar on his palm before he grips the edge of the table. 'Naolin... He was—' His jaw flexes.

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 may be the first GTA to have full-on "sex scenes", Hot Coffee not included
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 may feature actual sex scenes. The suggestion comes from an age-rating description for GTA 6 on the PlayStation Store, which states - if viewing the New Zealand or Australian versions of the Store - there are "sex scenes" in the game.
body: Should this be true, it could make GTA 6 the first Grand Theft Auto game to directly feature sexual intercourse. To feature it on purpose, that is; you might remember the infamous Hot Coffee scandal that surrounded GTA: San Andreas. A mod reinstated a sex mini-game Rockstar pulled out of San Andreas before release, causing all sorts of problems for the company.

Since then, GTA has featured risqué dalliances with sex workers in GTA games, involving some degree of nudity, but most actual sex scenes have happened off camera. There was that sex scene in GTA 4 expansion pack The Ballad of Gay Tony, but it only gave a brief glimpse at two characters humping with their clothes mostly on. There have been various depictions of oral sex, but again, they've been mostly obscured.

However, these age-rating descriptions - spotted by IGN - may not be accurate. They're not separately searchable on the relevant age-ratings boards' websites, despite the ESRB, PEGI and Australian Ratings Board's logos appearing on the PlayStation Store. Presumably this has something to do with embargoed information when posting fuller listings.
points: Grand Theft Auto 6 may feature actual sex scenes.

articles.title: Halo's new steward Activision reportedly considering rebooting the series, with a team in Sledgehammer Games leading the charge
articles.summary: We recently learned that Microsoft gave development of its next Halo game to Activision, where "a new purpose-built team" - separate from the teams working on Call of Duty - has been created to oversee the franchise going forward.
body: "Activision originally proposed two separate games: a free to play multiplayer game and a campaign-only game," Rebs Gaming said in the video. "I'm told Activision's original idea for the campaign-only game prototype was a soft reboot that doesn't follow Halo Infinite 's story but doesn't retcon any previously established canon." But Activision apparently mooted the idea of making two separate games - a multiplayer and single-player offering - instead opting to go for one package combining both elements, more in line with what we've seen from the Halo series to date.

If you're not a fan of the Halo novels, the closest we've come to a Master Chief origin story was in the slightly pants Halo Paramount Halo TV show, which was cancelled after two seasons. You have to wonder, if Activision does go back in time to show the ultra-fascist roots of Master Chief's rebellion-crushing origins, will he also have sex in front of Cortana in the game? Probably not, ey.

videos.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer Review
videos.summary: Star Wars: Galactic Racer reviewed by Luke Reilly on Xbox Series X. Also available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series S, and PC.
body: "Star Wars: Galactic Racer is a fabulous looking and frantically fast anti-grav racer that impressively goes further than just taking the decades-old Star Wars Racer games and giving them a 4K facelift. With a range of satisfyingly customisable vehicle classes beyond podracers, a world outside the racing you can soak in and explore in third-person, and an interesting roguelite-adjacent structure that injects a considerable degree of risk into the action, Galactic Racer is a fresh and accomplished blend of Lucas lore with the destructive spirit of arcade racing icons like Burnout and MotorStorm. Its run-based campaign can grow unavoidably tedious over long stints because of its heavy reliance on repeatedly revisiting the same slim selection of planets, and its lack of splitscreen is disappointing considering its roots run back to consoles regarded as the kings of same-couch chaos. But Galactic Racer is an otherwise confident debut from developer Fuse Games, and one that has successfully lit the afterburners on a long-dormant slice of the Star Wars universe."
points: Star Wars: Galactic Racer reviewed by Luke Reilly on Xbox Series X.
Also available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series S, and PC.

Ghost of Yōtei Complete Edition is available now.
Internet connection and account for PlayStation® required to download.
